Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.overview: Gordon Ryan's no-gi closed guard (formerly 'Systemizing Closed Guard'), which he built while recovering from surgery and couldn't rely on athleticism. Your copy has 7 files; the publisher lists 8 sections. It covers the side scissor to the back and armbar, the pendulum sweep into the wrong-way triangle and leg entries when they pull out, the top lock to armbar and solving the stack, flower sweep to kata gatame, knee pulls to the pinch headlock, overhook (clamp) and kimura, failed ude gatame follow-ups, the hip bump to triangle, and attacking a standing opponent. It ends with rolls and commentary.
Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.for: No-gi closed guard players of any age or athleticism.

Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.overview: Gordon Ryan's bottom half guard in eight volumes. Volume 1 introduces the half guard (and 'the John Danaher paradox'). Volume 2 covers the pinch headlock (multi-directional sumi gaeshi, to the shoulder crunch). Volume 3 covers the knee shield (getting underhooks from low and high knee, the lower leg shift). Volume 4 covers the knee lever and kimura. Volume 5 covers deep half (entering from butterfly half, leg entries when they put the far knee down). Volume 6 covers the scorpion position and 'heisting'. Volumes 7 and 8 are rolls with commentary.

Gordon Ryan's seated open guard in eight volumes (the folder's Contents.txt has timestamps). Volume 1 covers open guard body positions, distance, concave shoulders and ashi garami entries against a square stance (kouchi, double kouchi, 2-on-1). Volume 2 covers hand techniques (ankle pick series, Imanari roll) and staggered stances (de ashi harai, back take). Volume 3 covers a kneeling opponent: push-pull, the four quadrants, multidirectional sumi gaeshi and elevation into ashi garami. Volume 4 covers 2-on-1 elbow sweeps, hiza guruma and the under-over to kata gatame. Volume 5 covers the pinch headlock and shoulder crunch sumi gaeshi, double unders and countering the body lock. Volume 6 covers 'changing gears' and triangle and armbar entries off collar ties. Volumes 7 and 8 are rolls with commentary.
Gordon Ryan - COMPLETE Collection - as o.for: No-gi players who play seated guard.
